title: kb-verify lint.py given a kb/-prefixed article path lints nothing and prints errors=0 warnings=0, so a worker reports a clean lint the land then refuses
goal: lint.py (kb-verify) given an article path with the kb directory prefix lints that article as it does the root-relative path (public/<path>.md), and an argument that matches no article makes lint.py exit non-zero naming it instead of printing errors=0 warnings=0; found at the SP-up5wchen retrospective: the research worker reported lint errors=0 on its ten articles given with the prefix, and the land's lint refused a CODE tag without a path#symbol pointer in one of them.
